subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add dedicated observation-only reaction hook events to the public plugin API for Discord now, and should that payload be generic across channels or Discord-specific?
rationale: Current main proves the missing surface, but the fix adds public hook names and payload semantics that third-party plugins may depend on, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape alone.

options.title: Define Shared Reaction Hooks
options.body: Add generic observation-only reaction_added/reaction_removed-style hooks with a portable payload and Discord as the first wired channel.

options.title: Limit To Discord-Specific Hook
options.body: Add a Discord-only hook or payload now, accepting a later migration if other channels need parity.

options.title: Defer Hook API
options.body: Keep reactions as system events and continue tracking reaction-triggered turns or channel-specific work separately until maintainers want a plugin API expansion.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Reaction Hooks
recommendation.body: Add generic observation-only reaction_added/reaction_removed-style hooks with a portable payload and Discord as the first wired channel.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is the clearest recent route for the current plugin hook contract file that would need the public API change.
